en: Identify buildings that qualify as industrial buildings (IB)
Apply the 10% rule and the 75% rule
Compute initial and annual allowances and the residual expenditure
Compute balancing allowances and charges on disposal
ms: Kenal pasti bangunan yang layak sebagai bangunan industri (IB)
Hitung elaun permulaan dan elaun tahunan serta perbelanjaan baki
Hitung elaun dan caj imbangan semasa pelupusan

en: Allowances for industrial buildings and structures are given by reference to a basis period
No allowance on the cost of land or incidental costs connected with the land
The allowance is deducted against adjusted income
ms: Elaun bagi bangunan dan struktur industri diberi merujuk tempoh asas
Tiada elaun bagi kos tanah atau kos sampingan berkaitan tanah

blocks.en: Paragraphs 63–66 of Schedule 3 ITA define an industrial building; the building must be used for a specified purpose.
blocks.ms: Perenggan 63–66 Jadual 3 ITA mentakrifkan bangunan industri; bangunan mesti digunakan untuk tujuan yang ditetapkan.

blocks.en: Core buildings
blocks.ms: Bangunan teras

en: A factory equipped with plant and machinery to carry out manufacturing
Another building housing machinery or plant for manufacturing, or generating power for manufacturing
A workshop for repair or servicing of goods, if not done in conjunction with, or incidental to, selling those goods
A building in the same compound (same curtilage) used to store raw materials, fuel or stores for manufacture, or to store processed goods before sale
ms: Kilang yang dilengkapi loji dan jentera untuk pembuatan
Bangunan lain yang menempatkan jentera atau loji untuk pembuatan, atau menjana kuasa untuk pembuatan
Bengkel untuk membaiki atau menservis barangan, jika tidak dilakukan bersama atau sampingan kepada penjualan barangan itu
Bangunan dalam kawasan yang sama (curtilage sama) untuk menyimpan bahan mentah, bahan api atau stor untuk pembuatan, atau menyimpan barangan siap diproses sebelum dijual

blocks.en: ‘Within the same curtilage’ means a building adjoining or adjacent to, or in the land immediately surrounding, a building used as a factory.
blocks.ms: ‘Dalam curtilage yang sama’ bermaksud bangunan bersebelahan atau berhampiran, atau dalam tanah yang mengelilingi, bangunan yang digunakan sebagai kilang.

blocks.en: Other qualifying uses
blocks.ms: Kegunaan layak lain

en: Dock = repairing ships; wharf = ships load/unload cargo; depot or jetty = where boats and ships anchor
ms: Dok = membaiki kapal; jeti kargo = kapal memunggah/memuat; depot atau jeti = tempat bot dan kapal berlabuh

en: Business consists mainly of hiring storage space to the public
ms: Perniagaan terutamanya menyewakan ruang simpanan kepada orang awam

en: Supplying water or electricity to the public, or providing telecommunication services to the public
ms: Membekal air atau elektrik kepada orang awam, atau perkhidmatan telekomunikasi kepada orang awam

en: Used in working a farm / mine, provided no claim is made for qualifying agriculture / mining expenditure
ms: Digunakan untuk mengusahakan ladang / lombong, dengan syarat tiada tuntutan perbelanjaan pertanian / perlombongan layak

blocks.en: Employee facilities (para 65 Schedule 3)
blocks.ms: Kemudahan pekerja (para 65 Jadual 3)

en: If a building is an IB, a canteen, restroom, recreation room, lavatory, bathhouse, bathroom or washroom for employees is also treated as IB
A building for the welfare of farm workers, of little value except for the farm, is treated as IB
Living accommodation for employees who are not a director, an individual controlling the business, or management/administration/clerical staff (slide 10 text is cut off after this)
ms: Jika bangunan ialah IB, kantin, bilik rehat, bilik rekreasi, tandas, rumah mandi atau bilik air untuk pekerja juga dianggap IB
Bangunan untuk kebajikan pekerja ladang, yang bernilai kecil kecuali untuk ladang, dianggap IB
Tempat tinggal pekerja yang bukan pengarah, individu yang mengawal perniagaan, atau kakitangan pengurusan/pentadbiran/perkeranian (teks slaid 10 terpotong selepas ini)

en: Licensed private hospital, maternity home, nursing home
ms: Hospital swasta berlesen, rumah bersalin, rumah jagaan

en: Research building (approved research, or R&D / contract R&D company)
ms: Bangunan penyelidikan (penyelidikan diluluskan, atau syarikat R&D / R&D kontrak)

en: Warehouse solely for storing goods for export, or imported goods for processing/distribution/re-export
ms: Gudang semata-mata untuk menyimpan barangan eksport, atau barangan import untuk diproses/diedar/dieksport semula

en: Building for industrial, technical or vocational training
ms: Bangunan latihan perindustrian, teknikal atau vokasional

blocks.en: Slides 21 and 22 contain no readable text (figures).
blocks.ms: Slaid 21 dan 22 tiada teks yang boleh dibaca (rajah).

blocks.en: Owner must be the business operator (para 16B(1), PR 3/2018 para 8)
blocks.ms: Pemilik mesti pengendali perniagaan (para 16B(1), PR 3/2018 para 8)

blocks.en: From YA2016, for paras 37A–37H (hospital, research, warehouse, approved service project, hotel, airport, motor racing circuit), 42A (employee living accommodation, child care centre), 42B (school/educational institution) and 42C (training building), the person claiming IBA must be both the owner and the business operator. A landlord who rents the building to the operator cannot claim, although the tenant can claim IBA on its own alterations or renovations (but not for 37A and 37B). Example 8: Lestari bought a college and rented it to Smart Sdn Bhd; Lestari is not eligible.
blocks.ms: Dari YA2016, bagi para 37A–37H (hospital, penyelidikan, gudang, projek perkhidmatan diluluskan, hotel, lapangan terbang, litar lumba motor), 42A (penginapan pekerja, pusat jagaan kanak-kanak), 42B (sekolah/institusi pendidikan) dan 42C (bangunan latihan), pihak yang menuntut IBA mesti pemilik dan juga pengendali perniagaan. Tuan tanah yang menyewakan bangunan kepada pengendali tidak boleh menuntut, walaupun penyewa boleh menuntut IBA atas ubah atau pengubahsuaian sendiri (kecuali untuk 37A dan 37B). Contoh 8: Lestari membeli kolej dan menyewakannya kepada Smart Sdn Bhd; Lestari tidak layak.

blocks.en: If such an owner-operator rents out part of the building (e.g. canteen, pharmacy, cafeteria, laundry): rented floor area of 10% or less keeps the whole building qualifying; above 10% the rented part does not qualify, with its cost apportioned by floor area (PR 3/2018 para 8.3; Example 10: rented space 19.5% of 180,000 sq ft, so RM1,500,000 × 19.5% = RM292,500 is excluded and QBE is RM1,207,500).
blocks.ms: Jika pemilik-pengendali sedemikian menyewakan sebahagian bangunan (cth. kantin, farmasi, kafeteria, dobi): keluasan lantai disewakan 10% atau kurang mengekalkan kelayakan seluruh bangunan; melebihi 10% bahagian disewakan tidak layak, dengan kosnya diagihkan mengikut keluasan lantai (PR 3/2018 para 8.3; Contoh 10: ruang disewa 19.5% daripada 180,000 kaki persegi, jadi RM1,500,000 × 19.5% = RM292,500 dikecualikan dan QBE ialah RM1,207,500).

blocks.en: This answers the lecturer’s USSB / Q9 type questions: a company that buys a building and rents it to an operator of an educational institution (EduHub, Aurora Education) cannot claim IBA on it, because it is the owner but not the business operator; the operator (a tenant) may not claim IBA on the building itself either, as it does not own it.
blocks.ms: Ini menjawab soalan jenis USSB / S9 pensyarah: syarikat yang membeli bangunan dan menyewakannya kepada pengendali institusi pendidikan (EduHub, Aurora Education) tidak boleh menuntut IBA kerana ia pemilik tetapi bukan pengendali perniagaan; pengendali (penyewa) juga tidak boleh menuntut IBA atas bangunan itu kerana tidak memilikinya.

blocks.en: Dwelling houses, retail shops, showrooms and offices are not IBs. But under para 66 Schedule 3 (Rule 10%), if the part not used as an IB (office, rented out) does not exceed 10% of the construction cost of the building or extension, allowance is given on the entire building. PR 3/2018 para 9 says the cost of the non-IB part is measured by total construction cost, floor area, or another fair method approved by the DGIR.
blocks.ms: Rumah kediaman, kedai runcit, bilik pameran dan pejabat bukan IB. Namun di bawah para 66 Jadual 3 (Peraturan 10%), jika bahagian bukan IB (pejabat, disewakan) tidak melebihi 10% daripada kos pembinaan bangunan atau tambahan, elaun diberi ke atas keseluruhan bangunan. PR 3/2018 para 9 menyatakan kos bahagian bukan IB diukur mengikut jumlah kos pembinaan, keluasan lantai, atau kaedah adil lain yang diluluskan KPHDN.

en: Allowance only on the IB portion (examples: 80% IB when 20% office/showroom)
ms: Elaun hanya atas bahagian IB (contoh: 80% IB apabila 20% pejabat/bilik pameran)

blocks.en: Rule 75%
blocks.ms: Peraturan 75%

blocks.en: If expenditure on preparing, cutting, tunnelling or levelling land to install plant and machinery exceeds 75% of the aggregate of the plant and machinery cost and its installation cost, the total (plant, machinery and installation) is treated as expenditure on a building. If that building is an IB it qualifies for IBA, and the plant and machinery then do not qualify for capital allowance.
blocks.ms: Jika perbelanjaan menyediakan, memotong, menerowong atau meratakan tanah untuk memasang loji dan jentera melebihi 75% daripada jumlah kos loji dan jentera serta kos pemasangannya, keseluruhan (loji, jentera dan pemasangan) dianggap perbelanjaan bangunan. Jika bangunan itu IB, ia layak IBA, dan loji serta jentera tidak layak elaun modal.

blocks.en: Worked check (lecturer’s Q4, Sunrise): machinery 110,060 + installation 45,000 = 155,060; land preparation 30,000. Ratio = 30,000 ÷ (155,060 + 30,000) = 16% which is below 75%, so the machinery is claimed under capital allowances. Showroom + office = 2 of 12 parts = 17% (above 10%) so only the IB share (10/12) qualifies.
blocks.ms: Semakan kerja (S4 pensyarah, Sunrise): jentera 110,060 + pemasangan 45,000 = 155,060; penyediaan tanah 30,000. Nisbah = 30,000 ÷ (155,060 + 30,000) = 16% iaitu di bawah 75%, jadi jentera dituntut di bawah elaun modal. Bilik pameran + pejabat = 2 daripada 12 bahagian = 17% (melebihi 10%) jadi hanya bahagian IB (10/12) layak.

en: Cost of constructing buildings or structures used as IB
ms: Kos membina bangunan atau struktur untuk IB

en: Cost of land and other costs related to land
ms: Kos tanah dan kos lain berkaitan tanah

blocks.en: Also qualifying
blocks.ms: Turut layak

en: Digging and laying foundations for drains, water pipes and electric cables
Cost of preparing plans for local authority approval
Cost of clearing the old site where the old building was not an IB
Labour, materials, haulage, management, supervision and other overheads
Incidental work such as drainage, water and electricity installation; fittings forming part of the building
Legal charges and stamp duty related to the building or structure
Capital expenditure on additions, renovations (including structural changes and improvements) and alterations (an overall change of the original structure)
ms: Menggali dan meletakkan asas untuk longkang, paip air dan kabel elektrik
Kos menyediakan pelan untuk kelulusan pihak berkuasa tempatan
Kos membersihkan tapak lama jika bangunan lama bukan IB
Buruh, bahan, pengangkutan, pengurusan, penyeliaan dan overhed lain
Kerja sampingan seperti saliran, pemasangan air dan elektrik; lekapan yang menjadi sebahagian bangunan
Fi guaman dan duti setem berkaitan bangunan atau struktur
Perbelanjaan modal ke atas tambahan, pengubahsuaian (termasuk perubahan struktur dan penambahbaikan) dan ubahan (perubahan menyeluruh struktur asal)

sections.ref: Lecturer’s Example & Exercise (Q1, Q4, Q6, Q7)

blocks.en: The slides do not state the rates. The lecturer’s worked answers use an Initial Allowance (IA) of 10% and an Annual Allowance (AA) of 3% of QBE, with residual expenditure (RE) = QBE − allowances given.
blocks.ms: Slaid tidak menyatakan kadar. Jawapan kerja pensyarah menggunakan Elaun Permulaan (IA) 10% dan Elaun Tahunan (AA) 3% daripada QBE, dengan perbelanjaan baki (RE) = QBE − elaun diberi.

en: Qualifying costs (excl. land RM1.2m, RM3,600 land legal fees, RM300,000 demolition of old factory)
Total of stamp duty/legal 10,800 + architect 18,600 + levelling 480,000 + piling 288,000 + wiring 105,600 + internal roads 64,800 + construction 360,000
ms: Kos layak (tolak tanah RM1.2j, fi guaman tanah RM3,600, perobohan kilang lama RM300,000)
Jumlah duti setem/guaman 10,800 + arkitek 18,600 + perataan 480,000 + cerucuk 288,000 + pendawaian 105,600 + jalan dalaman 64,800 + pembinaan 360,000

blocks.en: In the lecturer’s answer the demolition of an old factory (RM300,000) is excluded, which is consistent with slide 24 (site clearing qualifies only if the old building was not an IB). The answer sheet gives no reasoning for this, so that explanation is my reading.
blocks.ms: Dalam jawapan pensyarah, perobohan kilang lama (RM300,000) dikecualikan, selaras dengan slaid 24 (pembersihan tapak layak hanya jika bangunan lama bukan IB). Lembaran jawapan tidak memberi sebab, jadi penjelasan itu bacaan saya.

blocks.en: Purchase of a used building
blocks.ms: Pembelian bangunan terpakai

blocks.en: PR 3/2018 (paras 4.2.2–4.2.4, 7): for a purchase from YA2005, QBE is the purchase price of the building, including the buyer’s legal fees, stamp duty and incidental costs but excluding the land (para 70 Schedule 3). If land and building are not priced separately, get a valuation (VPSD or professional valuer) and apportion the legal fees. In general IA is 10% and AA 3% of QBE ‘unless stated specifically at a different rate’ (para 7), and the claimant must own the building and use it (or be about to use it) for the business at the end of the basis period.
blocks.ms: PR 3/2018 (para 4.2.2–4.2.4, 7): bagi pembelian dari YA2005, QBE ialah harga belian bangunan, termasuk fi guaman, duti setem dan kos sampingan pembeli tetapi tidak termasuk tanah (para 70 Jadual 3). Jika tanah dan bangunan tidak diharga berasingan, dapatkan penilaian (JPPH atau penilai profesional) dan agihkan fi guaman. Secara amnya IA ialah 10% dan AA 3% daripada QBE ‘kecuali dinyatakan secara khusus pada kadar lain’ (para 7), dan pemohon mesti memiliki bangunan dan menggunakannya (atau akan menggunakannya) untuk perniagaan pada akhir tempoh asas.

blocks.en: PR 3/2018 examples: a buyer of a RM450,000 building gets IA 10% = 45,000 and AA 3% = 13,500; QBE for a second-hand factory bought at RM250,000 (land excluded) is RM250,000.
blocks.ms: Contoh PR 3/2018: pembeli bangunan RM450,000 mendapat IA 10% = 45,000 dan AA 3% = 13,500; QBE kilang terpakai dibeli pada RM250,000 (tanah dikecualikan) ialah RM250,000.

blocks.en: Check against the lecturer’s answer sheet: Care Maternity Home (hospital, para 37A) uses IA 10% + AA 3%, which matches the PR general rate. Hikari Sdn Bhd (industrial training centre) uses AA 10% with no IA; the only specific 10% case in PR 3/2018 is its Example 10 (an educational institution, para 42B, AA 10% and no IA shown), so Hikari’s rate looks like a specific rate for education/training buildings, not covered by the slides. Nangka Bhd (a factory bought second-hand) is shown as AA 10% (235,000) and then ‘3%’ with the same 235,000. Under the PR’s general rate it would be IA 10% (235,000) in YA2025 and AA 3% (70,500) a year after, so Nangka’s lines look like a typing slip. Confirm with your lecturer.
blocks.ms: Semakan terhadap lembaran jawapan pensyarah: Care Maternity Home (hospital, para 37A) guna IA 10% + AA 3%, selaras kadar am PR. Hikari Sdn Bhd (pusat latihan perindustrian) guna AA 10% tanpa IA; satu-satunya kes khusus 10% dalam PR 3/2018 ialah Contoh 10 (institusi pendidikan, para 42B, AA 10% tanpa IA ditunjuk), jadi kadar Hikari nampak sebagai kadar khusus bangunan pendidikan/latihan, tidak diliputi slaid. Nangka Bhd (kilang dibeli terpakai) ditunjuk AA 10% (235,000) kemudian ‘3%’ dengan 235,000 yang sama. Di bawah kadar am PR ia ialah IA 10% (235,000) dalam YA2025 dan AA 3% (70,500) setahun selepas itu, jadi baris Nangka nampak seperti kesilapan menaip. Sahkan dengan pensyarah.

title.en: Disposal, Balancing Adjustments and Special Cases
title.ms: Pelupusan, Pelarasan Imbangan dan Kes Khas

blocks.en: Disposal is deemed when
blocks.ms: Pelupusan dianggap berlaku apabila

en: The building is sold, transferred or assigned
In a concession, the concession comes to an end
The building is demolished or destroyed
The building ceases to be used as an IB
ms: Bangunan dijual, dipindah milik atau diserah hak
Bangunan tidak lagi digunakan sebagai IB

blocks.en: Disposal value is the market value on the date of sale, transfer or assignment, or the proceeds of sale.
blocks.ms: Nilai pelupusan ialah nilai pasaran pada tarikh jualan, pindah milik atau serah hak, atau hasil jualan.

en: Balancing charge, but cannot exceed total allowances actually given
ms: Caj imbangan, tetapi tidak boleh melebihi jumlah elaun yang sebenarnya diberi

blocks.en: Cempedak Bhd (lecturer’s Q6): QBE 1,600,000 (2,800,000 − land 1,200,000; the 1/11 office is under 10% so the whole building qualifies). IA 160,000 + AA 48,000 in YA2020, then 4 × 48,000 (YA2021–24); RE 1,200,000. Sold in YA2025 for 3,750,000 − land 1,400,000 = 2,350,000. Excess 1,150,000, but the charge is limited to allowances given: 160,000 + 48,000 + 192,000 = RM400,000.
blocks.ms: Cempedak Bhd (S6 pensyarah): QBE 1,600,000 (2,800,000 − tanah 1,200,000; pejabat 1/11 di bawah 10% jadi seluruh bangunan layak). IA 160,000 + AA 48,000 dalam YA2020, kemudian 4 × 48,000 (YA2021–24); RE 1,200,000. Dijual dalam YA2025 pada 3,750,000 − tanah 1,400,000 = 2,350,000. Lebihan 1,150,000, tetapi caj dihadkan kepada elaun diberi: 160,000 + 48,000 + 192,000 = RM400,000.

blocks.en: Temporary disuse (paras 55 and 57)
blocks.ms: Tidak digunakan sementara (para 55 dan 57)

blocks.en: An IB temporarily not used for the qualifying trade is deemed to be in use, and annual allowances continue, if it was used for the business immediately before, is kept properly maintained ready for use, and the disuse is only temporary.
blocks.ms: IB yang sementara tidak digunakan untuk perdagangan layak dianggap digunakan, dan elaun tahunan diteruskan, jika ia digunakan untuk perniagaan sejurus sebelumnya, diselenggara sedia untuk digunakan, dan tidak digunakan hanya sementara.

blocks.en: Owned for less than 2 years (para 71)
blocks.ms: Dimiliki kurang 2 tahun (para 71)

blocks.en: If a qualifying IB is disposed of within two years of its construction or purchase, allowances given earlier are withdrawn.
blocks.ms: Jika IB layak dilupuskan dalam dua tahun selepas pembinaan atau pembelian, elaun yang diberi sebelumnya ditarik balik.

blocks.en: Slides 21, 22 and 30 have no readable text; the rates, the 75%/10% worked ratios and the used-building treatment come from the lecturer’s example sheet and not from the slides.
blocks.ms: Slaid 21, 22 dan 30 tiada teks yang boleh dibaca; kadar, nisbah 75%/10% dan layanan bangunan terpakai datang daripada lembaran contoh pensyarah dan bukan slaid.

blocks.en: From Example_exercise_IBA.pdf (10 questions). I checked each lecturer’s answer against PR 3/2018 and PR 8/2016 and corrected what did not match; Q2, Q3, Q8, Q9 and Q10 have no lecturer answer, so those are my own workings. Rates used: IA 10% and AA 3% of QBE unless stated. QBE excludes land, legal fees on land, and demolition of an old industrial building (PR 3/2018 para 4.1.1).
blocks.ms: Daripada Example_exercise_IBA.pdf (10 soalan). Saya semak setiap jawapan pensyarah dengan PR 3/2018 dan PR 8/2016 dan betulkan yang tidak sepadan; Q2, Q3, Q8, Q9 dan Q10 tiada jawapan pensyarah, jadi itu pengiraan saya sendiri. Kadar: IA 10% dan AA 3% daripada QBE melainkan dinyatakan. QBE tidak termasuk tanah, fi guaman tanah, dan perobohan bangunan industri lama (PR 3/2018 para 4.1.1).

blocks.en: Q1: Eco Bhd (corrected basis periods)
blocks.ms: Q1: Eco Bhd (tempoh asas dibetulkan)

blocks.en: The building was completed 30.3.2025 and the year end is 31 March, so it is used in the basis period 1.4.2024–31.3.2025, which is YA2025.
blocks.ms: Bangunan siap 30.3.2025 dan akhir tahun 31 Mac, jadi ia digunakan dalam tempoh asas 1.4.2024–31.3.2025, iaitu YA2025.

blocks.en:
QBE: legal and stamp duty (14,400 − 3,600 land) 10,800
+ architect 18,600 + levelling and terracing 480,000 + piling and foundation 288,000
+ wiring and plumbing 105,600 + internal roads 64,800 + construction 360,000 = RM1,327,800
Excluded: land 1,200,000; land legal 3,600; demolition of the old factory 300,000 (an old industrial building, PR 3/2018 para 4.1.1 note (ii))
Non-industrial part 20% (office and showroom) is above 10%, so QBE = 80% × 1,327,800 = RM1,062,240

YA2025: IA 10% = 106,224; AA 3% = 31,867; RE = 1,062,240 − 138,091 = RM924,149
YA2026: AA 3% = 31,867; RE = RM892,282
blocks.ms:
QBE: guaman dan duti setem (14,400 − 3,600 tanah) 10,800
+ arkitek 18,600 + ratakan dan teres 480,000 + cerucuk dan asas 288,000
+ pendawaian dan paip 105,600 + jalan dalaman 64,800 + pembinaan 360,000 = RM1,327,800
Dikecualikan: tanah 1,200,000; guaman tanah 3,600; perobohan kilang lama 300,000 (bangunan industri lama, PR 3/2018 para 4.1.1 nota (ii))
Bahagian bukan industri 20% (pejabat dan bilik pameran) melebihi 10%, jadi QBE = 80% × 1,327,800 = RM1,062,240

YA2025: IA 10% = 106,224; AA 3% = 31,867; RE = 1,062,240 − 138,091 = RM924,149
YA2026: AA 3% = 31,867; RE = RM892,282

blocks.en: The lecturer’s numbers match, but the answer sheet’s YA table is shifted a year (it shows 1.4.24–31.3.25 as YA2026; a basis period ending in 2025 is YA2025). The lecturer also shows YA26–27 AA, but the question stops at YA2026, so RE after YA2026 is RM892,282 (the sheet’s RM860,415 is after YA2027).
blocks.ms: Nombor pensyarah sepadan, tetapi jadual YA pada lembaran jawapan beralih setahun (ia tunjuk 1.4.24–31.3.25 sebagai YA2026; tempoh asas berakhir 2025 ialah YA2025). Pensyarah juga tunjuk AA YA26–27, tetapi soalan berhenti pada YA2026, jadi RE selepas YA2026 ialah RM892,282 (RM860,415 pada lembaran ialah selepas YA2027).

blocks.en: Q2: Mega Sdn Bhd (revenue or capital)
blocks.ms: Q2: Mega Sdn Bhd (hasil atau modal)

en: (a) Replace broken floor tiles on every floor
Restores the asset to its original condition with no improvement; deductible under s33(1)(c)
ms: (a) Ganti jubin lantai pecah di setiap tingkat
Memulihkan aset kepada keadaan asal tanpa penambahbaikan; boleh ditolak di bawah s33(1)(c)

en: (b) Replace the old zinc roof with a new improved roof with cooling effects
A better roof with a new feature is an improvement that changes the original structure (compare the PR’s factory roof examples)
ms: (b) Ganti bumbung zink lama dengan bumbung baharu yang lebih baik dengan kesan penyejukan
Bumbung lebih baik dengan ciri baharu ialah penambahbaikan yang mengubah struktur asal (bandingkan contoh bumbung kilang dalam PR)

en: (c) Replace old wiring with new wiring on one floor for safety

Replacing a worn part of the whole building with equivalent wiring is a repair; one floor only, no change in the building’s character. It would be capital if the wiring were a higher specification upgrade
ms: (c) Ganti pendawaian lama dengan pendawaian baharu pada satu tingkat atas sebab keselamatan
Menggantikan bahagian usang bangunan dengan pendawaian setara ialah pembaikan; satu tingkat sahaja, tiada perubahan sifat bangunan. Ia modal jika pendawaian itu penaiktarafan spesifikasi lebih tinggi

en: (d) Replace faulty generator parts to keep using it
Replacing parts of the asset to continue using it, without improving it, is a repair
ms: (d) Ganti bahagian generator rosak supaya terus digunakan
Menggantikan bahagian aset untuk terus menggunakannya, tanpa menambah baik, ialah pembaikan

blocks.en: An office building is not an industrial building, so the capital cost in (b) earns no IBA.
blocks.ms: Bangunan pejabat bukan bangunan industri, jadi kos modal dalam (b) tidak mendapat IBA.

blocks.en: Q3: NusaVera Sdn Bhd (YA2026)
blocks.ms: Q3: NusaVera Sdn Bhd (YA2026)

blocks.en: Incorporated 1.7.2025, year end 30 June, so the first basis period is 1.7.2025–30.6.2026 (YA2026).
blocks.ms: Diperbadankan 1.7.2025, akhir tahun 30 Jun, jadi tempoh asas pertama ialah 1.7.2025–30.6.2026 (YA2026).

en: Cost of land is not QBE
Office 22,500 / 150,000 = 15%, above 10%, so the non-industrial part is excluded: 85% × 4,500,000
ms: Pejabat 22,500 / 150,000 = 15%, melebihi 10%, jadi bahagian bukan industri dikecualikan: 85% × 4,500,000

en: Storage of raw materials and finished goods within the factory curtilage, and workshop: industrial building
ms: Penyimpanan bahan mentah dan barang siap dalam kawasan kilang, serta bengkel: bangunan industri

en: Living accommodation by a manufacturer (para 42A(1)); the ground-floor surau and child care centre also serve employees (child care centre, para 42A(2); PR 8/2016 para 4.2)
ms: Penginapan pekerja oleh pengilang (para 42A(1)); surau dan pusat jagaan kanak-kanak di tingkat bawah juga untuk pekerja (pusat jagaan, para 42A(2); PR 8/2016 para 4.2)

en: Preparation cost 310,000 / aggregate 400,000 = 77.5%, above 75%, so the whole 400,000 is QBE and no capital allowance is given on the machine (PR 3/2018 para 5)
ms: Kos penyediaan 310,000 / agregat 400,000 = 77.5%, melebihi 75%, jadi seluruh 400,000 ialah QBE dan tiada elaun modal untuk mesin (PR 3/2018 para 5)

blocks.en: Assumption: the surau is treated as an employee welfare facility. If the ground floor (one third) were not treated as industrial, QBE of the quarters would be 600,000 under the 10% rule.
blocks.ms: Andaian: surau dianggap kemudahan kebajikan pekerja. Jika tingkat bawah (satu pertiga) tidak dianggap industri, QBE kuarters ialah 600,000 di bawah petua 10%.

blocks.en: Q4: Sunrise Bhd and Hikari Sdn Bhd
blocks.ms: Q4: Sunrise Bhd dan Hikari Sdn Bhd

blocks.en: Sunrise: year end 30 September; the building is used from 1.1.2023, in basis period 1.10.2022–30.9.2023 (YA2023). Sold 1.2.2025, in basis period 1.10.2024–30.9.2025 (YA2025). Hikari: year end 31 December, buys 1.2.2025 (YA2025).
blocks.ms: Sunrise: akhir tahun 30 September; bangunan digunakan dari 1.1.2023, dalam tempoh asas 1.10.2022–30.9.2023 (YA2023). Dijual 1.2.2025, dalam tempoh asas 1.10.2024–30.9.2025 (YA2025). Hikari: akhir tahun 31 Disember, beli 1.2.2025 (YA2025).

blocks.en:
Sunrise QBE: demolition of abandoned houses 15,000 (not an industrial building, new building on the same site) + construction 975,000 + architect 35,500 + wiring and plumbing 45,000 + roads and drainage 64,500 = RM1,135,000
Excluded: land 1,250,000 and land legal fee 10,500
Showroom and office = 2/12 = 16.7%, above 10%, so QBE = 10/12 × 1,135,000 = RM945,833

Machine 110,060 + installation 45,000 = 155,060; land preparation 30,000. Preparation 30,000 / aggregate 185,060 = 16%, not above 75%, so it is not QBE: claim plant allowances instead

YA2023: IA 94,583 + AA 28,375; RE = 822,875
YA2024: AA 28,375; RE = 794,500
YA2025 (sold 1.2.2025): no AA. Disposal value 1,800,000 − 450,000 land = 1,350,000, above RE 794,500 by 555,500
Balancing charge = the lower of 555,500 and the allowances given (94,583 + 28,375 + 28,375 = 151,333) = RM151,333
blocks.ms:
QBE Sunrise: perobohan rumah terbiar 15,000 (bukan bangunan industri, bangunan baharu di tapak sama) + pembinaan 975,000 + arkitek 35,500 + pendawaian dan paip 45,000 + jalan dan saliran 64,500 = RM1,135,000
Dikecualikan: tanah 1,250,000 dan fi guaman tanah 10,500
Bilik pameran dan pejabat = 2/12 = 16.7%, melebihi 10%, jadi QBE = 10/12 × 1,135,000 = RM945,833

Mesin 110,060 + pemasangan 45,000 = 155,060; penyediaan tanah 30,000. Penyediaan 30,000 / agregat 185,060 = 16%, tidak melebihi 75%, jadi bukan QBE: tuntut elaun loji

YA2023: IA 94,583 + AA 28,375; RE = 822,875
YA2024: AA 28,375; RE = 794,500
YA2025 (dijual 1.2.2025): tiada AA. Nilai pelupusan 1,800,000 − tanah 450,000 = 1,350,000, melebihi RE 794,500 sebanyak 555,500
Caj imbangan = yang lebih rendah antara 555,500 dan elaun diberi (94,583 + 28,375 + 28,375 = 151,333) = RM151,333

blocks.en:
Hikari QBE = purchase price of the building RM1,350,000 (PR 3/2018 para 4.2.4)
Using the lecturer’s rate for a training centre (IA nil, AA 10%):
YA2025: AA 135,000; RE = 1,215,000
YA2026: AA 135,000; RE = RM1,080,000
blocks.ms:
QBE Hikari = harga belian bangunan RM1,350,000 (PR 3/2018 para 4.2.4)
Menggunakan kadar pensyarah bagi pusat latihan (IA tiada, AA 10%):
YA2025: AA 135,000; RE = 1,215,000
YA2026: AA 135,000; RE = RM1,080,000

blocks.en: Corrections: the lecturer used .83 × 1,135,000 = 942,050 for Sunrise. The exact fraction is 10/12, which gives 945,833, so IA, AA and the charge change slightly (the charge becomes 151,333, not 150,728). Both answer sheets write ‘31/9’, which does not exist; use 30 September. Hikari’s AA 10% is the lecturer’s rate, which this PR does not state for a training centre; confirm it with your lecturer. If the general rates applied, Hikari would claim IA 135,000 + AA 40,500 in YA2025.
blocks.ms: Pembetulan: pensyarah guna .83 × 1,135,000 = 942,050 bagi Sunrise. Pecahan tepat ialah 10/12, memberi 945,833, jadi IA, AA dan caj berubah sedikit (caj menjadi 151,333, bukan 150,728). Kedua-dua lembaran jawapan menulis ‘31/9’ yang tidak wujud; guna 30 September. AA 10% Hikari ialah kadar pensyarah, yang tidak dinyatakan dalam PR ini bagi pusat latihan; sahkan dengan pensyarah. Jika kadar am terpakai, Hikari akan menuntut IA 135,000 + AA 40,500 dalam YA2025.

blocks.en: (ii) A building that stores raw materials or finished goods is an industrial building if it is within the same curtilage as the factory: adjoining the factory building or on the land immediately surrounding it.
blocks.ms: (ii) Bangunan yang menyimpan bahan mentah atau barang siap ialah bangunan industri jika berada dalam kawasan (curtilage) yang sama dengan kilang: bersebelahan bangunan kilang atau di tanah yang betul-betul mengelilinginya.

blocks.en: Q5: Uni Spa Sdn Bhd (USSB)
blocks.ms: Q5: Uni Spa Sdn Bhd (USSB)

blocks.en:
In use 1.6.2025 (YA2025, year end 31 December).
QBE: contractor agreement legal 25,000 + architect and plan 30,000 + wiring and plumbing 70,000 + construction 2,225,000 + fixtures and fittings 40,000 = RM2,390,000
Excluded: land 1,000,000; legal on land 65,000; demolition of the existing factory 45,000 (an old industrial building)
Administration 12% and the rented-out canteen (about 13%) are each above 10%, so only 75% qualifies: QBE = 75% × 2,390,000 = RM1,792,500

YA2025: IA 179,250; AA 53,775; RE = 1,559,475
YA2026: AA 53,775; RE = RM1,505,700

Three-storey building bought July 2026 for RM3,000,000 and rented to an approved educational institution: USSB is not the business operator, so it cannot claim IBA (PR 3/2018 para 8.1.2, Example 8).
blocks.ms:
Digunakan 1.6.2025 (YA2025, akhir tahun 31 Disember).
QBE: guaman perjanjian kontraktor 25,000 + arkitek dan pelan 30,000 + pendawaian dan paip 70,000 + pembinaan 2,225,000 + lekapan dan kelengkapan 40,000 = RM2,390,000
Dikecualikan: tanah 1,000,000; guaman tanah 65,000; perobohan kilang sedia ada 45,000 (bangunan industri lama)
Pentadbiran 12% dan kantin disewakan (kira-kira 13%) masing-masing melebihi 10%, jadi hanya 75% layak: QBE = 75% × 2,390,000 = RM1,792,500

YA2025: IA 179,250; AA 53,775; RE = 1,559,475
YA2026: AA 53,775; RE = RM1,505,700

Bangunan tiga tingkat dibeli Julai 2026 pada RM3,000,000 dan disewakan kepada institusi pendidikan diluluskan: USSB bukan pengendali perniagaan, jadi tidak boleh menuntut IBA (PR 3/2018 para 8.1.2, Contoh 8).

blocks.en: (ii) ‘Within the same curtilage’: a building adjoining, or on the land immediately surrounding, a building used as a factory.
blocks.ms: (ii) ‘Dalam kawasan yang sama’: bangunan bersebelahan, atau di tanah yang betul-betul mengelilingi, bangunan yang digunakan sebagai kilang.

blocks.en: The lecturer’s answer for the factory matches PR 3/2018. The second purchase is not answered on the sheet; the answer above is mine.
blocks.ms: Jawapan pensyarah bagi kilang sepadan dengan PR 3/2018. Pembelian kedua tidak dijawab pada lembaran; jawapan di atas ialah jawapan saya.

blocks.en: Q6: Cempedak Bhd and Nangka Bhd
blocks.ms: Q6: Cempedak Bhd dan Nangka Bhd

blocks.en:
Year end 31 March. Cempedak: completed 1.11.2019 is YA2020 (1.4.2019–31.3.2020). Sold 1.2.2025 is YA2025.
QBE = 2,800,000 − land 1,200,000 = 1,600,000 (office 1/11 = 9.1%, within 10%, so the whole building qualifies)
YA2020: IA 160,000 + AA 48,000; RE = 1,392,000
YA2021–2024: AA 48,000 × 4 = 192,000; RE = 1,200,000
YA2025: disposal value 3,750,000 − 1,400,000 = 2,350,000; excess 1,150,000; allowances given 400,000
Balancing charge = RM400,000 (the lower)

Nangka (YA2025): QBE = purchase price of the building RM2,350,000; IA 10% = 235,000; AA 3% = 70,500; RE = 2,044,500
YA2026: AA 3% = 70,500; RE = RM1,974,000
The RM140,000 warehouse extension was completed 2.5.2026, which is in the basis period 1.4.2026–31.3.2027 (YA2027), so nothing for YA2026.
blocks.ms:
Akhir tahun 31 Mac. Cempedak: siap 1.11.2019 ialah YA2020 (1.4.2019–31.3.2020). Dijual 1.2.2025 ialah YA2025.
QBE = 2,800,000 − tanah 1,200,000 = 1,600,000 (pejabat 1/11 = 9.1%, dalam 10%, jadi seluruh bangunan layak)
YA2020: IA 160,000 + AA 48,000; RE = 1,392,000
YA2021–2024: AA 48,000 × 4 = 192,000; RE = 1,200,000
YA2025: nilai pelupusan 3,750,000 − 1,400,000 = 2,350,000; lebihan 1,150,000; elaun diberi 400,000
Caj imbangan = RM400,000 (yang lebih rendah)

Nangka (YA2025): QBE = harga belian bangunan RM2,350,000; IA 10% = 235,000; AA 3% = 70,500; RE = 2,044,500
YA2026: AA 3% = 70,500; RE = RM1,974,000
Sambungan gudang RM140,000 siap 2.5.2026, iaitu dalam tempoh asas 1.4.2026–31.3.2027 (YA2027), jadi tiada untuk YA2026.

blocks.en: Cempedak matches the lecturer. For Nangka the sheet writes IA 0% and AA 10% = 235,000, then ‘3%’ with 235,000 again; that is inconsistent, and the PR’s general rate (IA 10% + AA 3%) gives the figures above. The sheet’s RE lines for Nangka are blank.
blocks.ms: Cempedak sepadan dengan pensyarah. Bagi Nangka lembaran menulis IA 0% dan AA 10% = 235,000, kemudian ‘3%’ dengan 235,000 lagi; ia tidak konsisten, dan kadar am PR (IA 10% + AA 3%) memberi angka di atas. Baris RE Nangka pada lembaran kosong.

blocks.en: Q7: Remedy Private Hospital and Care Maternity Home
blocks.ms: Q7: Remedy Private Hospital dan Care Maternity Home

blocks.en:
Remedy (year end 30 June): in use 17.4.2022, in basis period 1.7.2021–30.6.2022 (YA2022). Licensed private hospital, para 37A.
QBE before exclusion: legal on the building 5,000 + levelling 20,000 + Block A 565,000 + canteen and staff room 30,000 + R&D lab 25,000 = RM645,000. (Land 175,000 and land legal 5,000 are out.)
Office and mini shop = 1/6 of the hospital block = 94,167 (about 14.6% of 645,000), above 10%, so it is excluded: QBE = 645,000 − 94,167 = RM550,833

YA2022: IA 55,083; AA 16,525; RE = 479,225
YA2023 and YA2024: AA 16,525 × 2 = 33,050; RE = 446,175
YA2025 (sold 16.3.2025, basis period 1.7.2024–30.6.2025): no AA. Disposal value 1,000,000 − 200,000 land = 800,000, above RE by 353,825; allowances given 55,083 + 49,575 = 104,658
Balancing charge = RM104,658

Care Maternity (year end 31 July): purchase 16.3.2025 is in basis period 1.8.2024–31.7.2025 (YA2025).
QBE = purchase price of the building RM800,000
YA2025: IA 80,000 + AA 24,000; RE = 696,000
YA2026: AA 24,000; RE = RM672,000
blocks.ms:
Remedy (akhir tahun 30 Jun): digunakan 17.4.2022, dalam tempoh asas 1.7.2021–30.6.2022 (YA2022). Hospital swasta berlesen, para 37A.
QBE sebelum pengecualian: guaman bangunan 5,000 + ratakan 20,000 + Blok A 565,000 + kantin dan bilik staf 30,000 + makmal R&D 25,000 = RM645,000. (Tanah 175,000 dan guaman tanah 5,000 dikecualikan.)
Pejabat dan kedai mini = 1/6 blok hospital = 94,167 (kira-kira 14.6% daripada 645,000), melebihi 10%, jadi dikecualikan: QBE = 645,000 − 94,167 = RM550,833

YA2022: IA 55,083; AA 16,525; RE = 479,225
YA2023 dan YA2024: AA 16,525 × 2 = 33,050; RE = 446,175
YA2025 (dijual 16.3.2025, tempoh asas 1.7.2024–30.6.2025): tiada AA. Nilai pelupusan 1,000,000 − tanah 200,000 = 800,000, melebihi RE sebanyak 353,825; elaun diberi 55,083 + 49,575 = 104,658
Caj imbangan = RM104,658

Care Maternity (akhir tahun 31 Julai): belian 16.3.2025 dalam tempoh asas 1.8.2024–31.7.2025 (YA2025).
QBE = harga belian bangunan RM800,000
YA2025: IA 80,000 + AA 24,000; RE = 696,000
YA2026: AA 24,000; RE = RM672,000

blocks.en: The lecturer gave two Remedy workings (QBE 535,350 and 530,833) that disagree with each other, and left the charge blank. Neither includes the levelling cost and the 10% test consistently; I included levelling (site works, PR 3/2018 para 4.1.1(e)) and took 1/6 of the hospital block’s cost as the non-industrial part. Care Maternity matches the lecturer.
blocks.ms: Pensyarah memberi dua pengiraan Remedy (QBE 535,350 dan 530,833) yang bercanggah, dan membiarkan caj kosong. Kedua-duanya tidak memasukkan kos ratakan dan ujian 10% secara konsisten; saya masukkan ratakan (kerja tapak, PR 3/2018 para 4.1.1(e)) dan ambil 1/6 kos blok hospital sebagai bahagian bukan industri. Care Maternity sepadan dengan pensyarah.

blocks.en: Q8: Dingin Sdn Bhd
blocks.ms: Q8: Dingin Sdn Bhd

blocks.en: The lecturer’s answer for Q8 is a copy of the Remedy sheet, so this is my own working. Year end 31 December: YA2025 = 1.1.2025–31.12.2025; YA2026 = 1.1.2026–31.12.2026.
blocks.ms: Jawapan pensyarah bagi Q8 ialah salinan lembaran Remedy, jadi ini pengiraan saya sendiri. Akhir tahun 31 Disember: YA2025 = 1.1.2025–31.12.2025; YA2026 = 1.1.2026–31.12.2026.

blocks.en:
(a) YA2025
Air-conditioner business
- Factory 1,500,000: the showroom 105,000 is 7%, within 10%, so the whole building qualifies. AA 3% = 45,000 (IA was given in YA2022)
- Office extension 151,000: wholly non-industrial, not QBE: nil
- Machine 75,000 + site preparation 225,000 = 300,000. Preparation is exactly 75%, not above 75%, so it is not QBE; claim plant allowances on 300,000 (assuming general rates IA 20%, AA 14%): 60,000 + 42,000 = 102,000
Electric fan business
- Factory 100,000: AA 3% = 3,000
- Replacing the whole cement floor with tiles, 45,000: an improvement (capital), qualifying as an alteration to an industrial building: IA 4,500 + AA 1,350 = 5,850
Total IBA YA2025 = 45,000 + 3,000 + 5,850 = RM53,850; plant allowances = RM102,000
blocks.ms:
(a) YA2025
Perniagaan penyaman udara
- Kilang 1,500,000: bilik pameran 105,000 ialah 7%, dalam 10%, jadi seluruh bangunan layak. AA 3% = 45,000 (IA diberi dalam YA2022)
- Sambungan pejabat 151,000: sepenuhnya bukan industri, bukan QBE: tiada
- Mesin 75,000 + penyediaan tapak 225,000 = 300,000. Penyediaan tepat 75%, tidak melebihi 75%, jadi bukan QBE; tuntut elaun loji atas 300,000 (andaian kadar am IA 20%, AA 14%): 60,000 + 42,000 = 102,000
Perniagaan kipas elektrik
- Kilang 100,000: AA 3% = 3,000
- Menggantikan seluruh lapisan lantai simen dengan jubin, 45,000: penambahbaikan (modal), layak sebagai ubahan bangunan industri: IA 4,500 + AA 1,350 = 5,850
Jumlah IBA YA2025 = 45,000 + 3,000 + 5,850 = RM53,850; elaun loji = RM102,000

blocks.en:
(b) YA2026
Air-conditioner business: adjusted income 236,000
− IBA on the factory 45,000 − plant AA 14% × 300,000 = 42,000
Statutory income = RM149,000

Electric fan business: factory sold 3.3.2026 for 250,000 − land 140,000 = 110,000
QBE 100,000 + 45,000 = 145,000; allowances given: 10,000 + 3,000 × 4 (YA2022–25) + 5,850 = 27,850; RE = 117,150
Sale below RE: balancing allowance = 117,150 − 110,000 = 7,150 (no AA in the year of sale)
Statutory income = 34,000 − 7,150 = RM26,850
blocks.ms:
(b) YA2026
Perniagaan penyaman udara: pendapatan diselaraskan 236,000
− IBA kilang 45,000 − AA loji 14% × 300,000 = 42,000
Pendapatan berkanun = RM149,000

Perniagaan kipas elektrik: kilang dijual 3.3.2026 pada 250,000 − tanah 140,000 = 110,000
QBE 100,000 + 45,000 = 145,000; elaun diberi: 10,000 + 3,000 × 4 (YA2022–25) + 5,850 = 27,850; RE = 117,150
Jualan di bawah RE: elaun imbangan = 117,150 − 110,000 = 7,150 (tiada AA dalam tahun jualan)
Pendapatan berkanun = 34,000 − 7,150 = RM26,850

blocks.en: Plant allowances use the general rates (IA 20%, AA 14%), which belong to the capital allowance chapter, not these slides. The 70% restriction on capital allowances does not bite here: 42,000 is well below 70% of the adjusted income net of IBA.
blocks.ms: Elaun loji menggunakan kadar am (IA 20%, AA 14%), yang tergolong dalam bab elaun modal, bukan slaid ini. Had 70% elaun modal tidak menjejaskan di sini: 42,000 jauh di bawah 70% pendapatan diselaraskan bersih IBA.

blocks.en: Q9: Sustain Me Manufacturing Industries (SMMI)
blocks.ms: Q9: Sustain Me Manufacturing Industries (SMMI)

blocks.en:
Year end 30 June. The building is used from April 2025, in basis period 1.7.2024–30.6.2025 (YA2025).
QBE: building cost 2,850,000 (land 5,000,000 excluded)
Sales/administration office 41,250 / 275,000 = 15%, above 10%, so QBE = 85% × 2,850,000 = RM2,422,500
YA2025: IA 242,250; AA 72,675; RE = 2,107,575

Sold May 2026 (YA2026, basis period 1.7.2025–30.6.2026) for RM3,500,000 (taken as the price of the building): no AA in YA2026
Disposal value 3,500,000 is above RE 2,107,575 by 1,392,425; allowances given 314,925
Balancing charge = RM314,925

The three-storey building bought June 2026 and rented to an educational institution: SMMI is not the business operator, so no IBA (PR 3/2018 para 8.1.2).
blocks.ms:
Akhir tahun 30 Jun. Bangunan digunakan dari April 2025, dalam tempoh asas 1.7.2024–30.6.2025 (YA2025).
QBE: kos bangunan 2,850,000 (tanah 5,000,000 dikecualikan)
Pejabat jualan/pentadbiran 41,250 / 275,000 = 15%, melebihi 10%, jadi QBE = 85% × 2,850,000 = RM2,422,500
YA2025: IA 242,250; AA 72,675; RE = 2,107,575

Dijual Mei 2026 (YA2026, tempoh asas 1.7.2025–30.6.2026) pada RM3,500,000 (diambil sebagai harga bangunan): tiada AA dalam YA2026
Nilai pelupusan 3,500,000 melebihi RE 2,107,575 sebanyak 1,392,425; elaun diberi 314,925
Caj imbangan = RM314,925

Bangunan tiga tingkat dibeli Jun 2026 dan disewakan kepada institusi pendidikan: SMMI bukan pengendali perniagaan, jadi tiada IBA (PR 3/2018 para 8.1.2).

blocks.en: (b) AESB is not eligible. It only rents the building and has not incurred the QBE; IBA belongs to the owner, and for an educational institution the owner must also be the business operator (para 16B(1); PR 3/2018 Example 8).
blocks.ms: (b) AESB tidak layak. Ia hanya menyewa bangunan dan tidak menanggung QBE; IBA milik pemilik, dan bagi institusi pendidikan pemilik mesti juga pengendali perniagaan (para 16B(1); PR 3/2018 Contoh 8).

blocks.en: Q10: Glory Sdn Bhd (YA2026)
blocks.ms: Q10: Glory Sdn Bhd (YA2026)

blocks.en:
QBE: demolition of the car showroom 410,000 (a showroom is not an industrial building, and the new factory is on the same site) + factory 6,300,000 + warehouse 360,000 = RM7,070,000
Excluded: land 560,000 and stamp duty on the land 10,000
The warehouse is within the factory curtilage and stores the company’s goods, so it is an industrial building; the 20% area is not a non-industrial part, so the 10% rule does not remove it

IA 10% = RM707,000
AA 3% = RM212,100
Total YA2026 = RM919,100; RE = RM6,150,900
blocks.ms:
QBE: perobohan bilik pameran kereta 410,000 (bilik pameran bukan bangunan industri, dan kilang baharu di tapak sama) + kilang 6,300,000 + gudang 360,000 = RM7,070,000
Dikecualikan: tanah 560,000 dan duti setem tanah 10,000
Gudang berada dalam kawasan kilang dan menyimpan barang syarikat, jadi ia bangunan industri; keluasan 20% bukan bahagian bukan industri, jadi petua 10% tidak mengecualikannya

IA 10% = RM707,000
AA 3% = RM212,100
Jumlah YA2026 = RM919,100; RE = RM6,150,900

q.en: Is land cost eligible for IBA?
q.ms: Adakah kos tanah layak IBA?

a.en: No. Land and incidental land costs are excluded.
a.ms: Tidak. Tanah dan kos sampingan tanah dikecualikan.

q.en: What does ‘same curtilage’ mean?
q.ms: Apakah maksud ‘curtilage sama’?

a.en: A building adjoining or adjacent to, or in the land immediately surrounding, a factory building.
a.ms: Bangunan bersebelahan atau berhampiran, atau dalam tanah yang mengelilingi, bangunan kilang.

q.en: Define dock, wharf, jetty/depot.
q.ms: Takrif dok, jeti kargo, jeti/depot.

a.en: Dock: repair ships; wharf: cargo ships load/unload; depot/jetty: boats and ships anchor.
a.ms: Dok: membaiki kapal; wharf: kapal kargo muat/turun; depot/jeti: bot dan kapal berlabuh.

q.en: Which employee facilities are treated as IB?
q.ms: Kemudahan pekerja mana dianggap IB?

a.en: Canteen, restroom, recreation room, lavatory, bathhouse, bathroom, washroom for employees of an IB.
a.ms: Kantin, bilik rehat, bilik rekreasi, tandas, rumah mandi, bilik air untuk pekerja IB.

q.en: Which paragraph covers hotels and airports?
q.ms: Para mana meliputi hotel dan lapangan terbang?

a.en: Hotel: 37F; airport: 37G.
a.ms: Hotel: 37F; lapangan terbang: 37G.

q.en: Which paragraph covers private hospitals?
q.ms: Para mana meliputi hospital swasta?

a.en: Para 37A (licensed private hospital, maternity home, nursing home).

q.en: State Rule 10%.
q.ms: Nyatakan Peraturan 10%.

a.en: If the non-IB part (office etc.) is 10% or less of the construction cost, allowance is given on the entire building.
a.ms: Jika bahagian bukan IB (pejabat dll.) 10% atau kurang daripada kos pembinaan, elaun diberi atas seluruh bangunan.

q.en: State Rule 75%.
q.ms: Nyatakan Peraturan 75%.

a.en: If land preparation exceeds 75% of plant & machinery cost plus installation, the total is treated as building expenditure.
a.ms: Jika penyediaan tanah melebihi 75% kos loji & jentera serta pemasangan, jumlahnya dianggap perbelanjaan bangunan.

q.en: Under Rule 75%, do the plant and machinery get capital allowance?
q.ms: Di bawah Peraturan 75%, adakah loji dan jentera dapat elaun modal?

a.en: No.
a.ms: Tidak.

q.en: Is demolition cost of an old IB site clearing a QBE?
q.ms: Adakah kos pembersihan tapak lama (bangunan lama IB) QBE?

a.en: Site clearing qualifies only if the old building was not an IB (slide 24).
a.ms: Pembersihan tapak layak hanya jika bangunan lama bukan IB (slaid 24).

q.en: Name five items that qualify as QBE.
q.ms: Namakan lima item QBE.

a.en: Architect’s fees, foundations for drains/pipes/cables, plans for approval, overheads, legal charges and stamp duty (also additions, renovations, alterations).
a.ms: Yuran arkitek, asas untuk longkang/paip/kabel, pelan kelulusan, overhed, fi guaman dan duti setem (juga tambahan, pengubahsuaian, ubahan).

a.ms: IA 10% dan AA 3% daripada QBE.

q.en: When is disposal deemed to occur?
q.ms: Bila pelupusan dianggap berlaku?

a.en: Sold/transferred/assigned, concession ends, demolished/destroyed, or ceases to be used as IB.
a.ms: Dijual/dipindah/diserah hak, konsesi tamat, dirobohkan/musnah, atau tidak lagi digunakan sebagai IB.

q.en: When does a balancing allowance arise?
q.ms: Bila elaun imbangan timbul?

a.en: When disposal value is less than residual expenditure.
a.ms: Apabila nilai pelupusan kurang daripada perbelanjaan baki.

q.en: Limit of a balancing charge?
q.ms: Had caj imbangan?

a.en: It cannot exceed total allowances actually given.
a.ms: Tidak boleh melebihi jumlah elaun yang sebenarnya diberi.

q.en: Temporary disuse: conditions?
q.ms: Tidak guna sementara: syarat?

a.en: Used for the business just before, kept maintained ready for use, and disuse is temporary.
a.ms: Digunakan untuk perniagaan sebelumnya, diselenggara sedia digunakan, dan tidak digunakan hanya sementara.
